entry.title: New: Bill 222 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
REPEALS ORDINANCE NO. 10-2, WHICH AMENDED SECTION 25-8-3 (NORTH KONA ZONE MAP), ARTICLE 8, CHAPTER 25 (ZONING CODE) OF THE HAWAI‘I COUNTY CODE 1983 (2005 EDITION), BY CHANGING THE DISTRICT CLASSIFICATION FROM AGRICULTURAL – 5 ACRES (A-5a) TO SINGLE FAMILY RESIDENTIAL – 10,000 SQUARE FEET (RS-10) AT KAHULUI 2ND, NORTH KONA, HAWAIʻI, COVERED BY TAX MAP KEY: 7-5-017:042 (Planning

Director Initiated) (Area: 14.437 acres) The Leeward Planning Commission forwards its favorable recommendation to revert the State Land Use Boundaries Map district classification to Agricultural and the Zoning district classification to Agricultural 5-acre. This property is located on the south side of Hualālai Road, approximately 0.6 miles east of its intersection with Queen Kaʻahumanu Highway.

Latest action: Council: Bill 222 passes second & final reading - 12/18/24
